objective: Close the exact local Scarab rule/configuration fingerprint using only public or passive visual evidence before any wager, login, cash insertion or execution consideration.

requiredObservations.question: Does the cabinet/game selection or help screen visibly identify Scarab?
acceptedEvidence: machine help/rules screen photographed before wagering

requiredObservations.question: Which IGT cabinet/platform is physically running Scarab (Crystal Dual, Crystal Slant, other)?
acceptedEvidence: help/diagnostic identification visible without restricted access

requiredObservations.question: Does the active Scarab configuration use 40 or 75 paylines?
Is Game X of 10 shown and do gold frames settle on the tenth cycle round before reset?
Does Wild pay 2/20/50/200 line credits for 2/3/4/5 consecutive Wilds from the left?
Does total bet scale exactly with the active payline count/line stake as required by the lower-bound engine?
acceptedEvidence: simultaneous visible total bet + active line count + coin/line stake

requiredObservations.question: Are frame positions and cycle counter remembered separately for the same bet level/denomination?
acceptedEvidence: passive observation without changing or placing a wager

requiredObservations.question: Does a nonzero framed state remain visible to the next user after the prior player leaves/cashes out at the same bet level?
acceptedEvidence: local operator/manufacturer rules explicitly describing persistence

requiredObservations.question: What maximum award/transaction cap applies to this machine and does it truncate any claimed deterministic lower bound?
Can the exact ordered 40/75 payline row matrix be recovered?
acceptedEvidence: exact certified rules/par sheet bound to the local build
requiredObservations.note: Needed only for partial-frame deterministic bounds; full-prefix theorem does not require exact geometry.

requiredObservations.question: Can a public/help/model identifier bind La Toja to a Scarab binary/game family without entering restricted diagnostics?
